description_en: Queries the list of model templates
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center list-model-templates --biz-type 1 --agent-platform ENTERPRISE --agent-provider OpenClaw --model-template-id-list mt-xxxx --has-model true --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListModelTemplates

parameters.help_en: The Agent provider list. If both this parameter and AgentProvider are specified, AgentProvider takes precedence and this list is ignored
parameters.help_zh: Agent提供商列表（与 AgentProvider 同时传时以 AgentProvider 为准，本列表被忽略）
parameters.name: agent_provider_list

parameters.help_en: The Agent platform list. If both this parameter and AgentPlatform are specified, AgentPlatform takes precedence and this list is ignored
parameters.help_zh: Agent平台列表（与 AgentPlatform 同时传时以 AgentPlatform 为准，本列表被忽略）
parameters.name: agent_platform_list

parameters.help_en: The list of template group IDs to filter by
parameters.name: model_template_id_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether models are configured in the group
parameters.name: has_model

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. Values 0 and 1 return the same result
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从1开始，0和1返回相同结果
parameters.name: page_number
